name: SciFiWorld
blurb: A sci-fi and pop-culture fair at Helsingborg Arena in Sweden, branded 'SciFiWorld West', with actor guests, cosplay and prop exhibits.
notes: Site uses old-style HTML frames (scifiworld.se itself renders empty; the real content is the linked frame page main_M2026.html). That page's only announced edition, 'SciFiWorld West' at Helsingborg Arena, ran 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-04 (confirmed by hbgarena.se, visithelsingborg.com and allevents.in) — one day before this window opens (2026-10-05) and hbgarena.se's own page already says the event 'har redan ägt rum' (has already taken place). No 2027 date is announced anywhere (own site, WebSearch, Facebook/Instagram/TikTok handles @scifiworld / @scifiworld.se mentioned on the page were not checked further within budget), so editions is left empty rather than guessed. For reference only (not recorded as structured guests, since no in-window edition exists to attach them to): the Oct 2026 edition's announced guests were Edward Furlong, Michael Winslow, Dave Barclay, Ted Åström, Cinzia Monreale and Lamberto Bava.
